description: A constant-return sibling function does not depend on the changed function.

expected_unaffected.tests/test_control.py::test_control: Calls only unchanged control.healthy in an independent subsystem.
expected_unaffected.tests/test_health.py::test_health: Only calls core.healthy, whose body and dependencies are unchanged; price has no side effects.

false_positives.tests/test_health.py::test_health: The test module imports core, so module-level fallback reaches the changed core module.

limitations: Module fallback treats an import as dependency on all semantic changes in that module, overselecting an independent sibling test.
